name: Stainless Steel Pipe-Clamp Bracket
description: A 316 stainless steel wall bracket for supporting a 100 kg process pipe 150 mm from the wall face. Mounts via six M10 bolts in a 3×2 grid. Stainless 316 is 3× denser than aluminum and 6.4× denser than PLA — every cubic millimeter costs far more than in plastic or aluminum designs. Optimal topology will be extreme open-lattice or thin-walled I-beam sections. Minimize mass while surviving the combined bending and shear load.
